article.title: Trump’s Nepo Sister Pick Stays Mum on Red Flag Topic
article.summary: Lindsey Graham’s sister refused to clarify her stance on the results of the 2020 presidential election despite her own brother’s acceptance of Donald Trump’s loss.Darline Graham, who filled her late brother’s Senate seat at the request of the president following his death last month, was asked about her thoughts on the 2020 election during a press conference on Monday,MS NOWreported.“Senator, you just mentioned that you agree with your brother on everything except for one matter, that being illegal immigration; you’d go farther than him on that,” MS NOW congressional reporter Mychael Schnell told Graham. “That being said, I’m curious, do you agree with him about the 2020 election, that Joe Biden was certified the winner of that election, was lawfully elected, and that you would’ve voted to certify the election as your brother did?”Read more at The Daily Beast.
